columns.name: MMWR_WEEK
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control

columns.name: WEEK_START
columns.description: Beginning date of the the MMWR week

columns.name: WEEK_END
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week

columns.name: FLU_RISK_LEVEL
columns.description: The risk of influenza infection based on current activity among surveillance indicators.

columns.name: INFLUENZA_SEASON
columns.description: Annually recurring time period of increased influenza activity standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: HOSP_FLU_ICU_WEEKLY
columns.description: Total number of ICU admissions for influenza

columns.name: HOSP_FLU_ICU_CUMULATIVE
columns.description: Cumulative total of ICU admissions for influenza in the flu season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 20 of the following year

columns.name: LAB_FLU_TESTED
columns.description: Total number of specimens tested for influenza as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: LAB_FLU_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of specimens that were positive for influenza as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: LAB_FLU_PCT_POSITIVE
columns.description: Percentage of specimens that were positive for influenza as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: LAB_TOT_A_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of specimens testing positive for influenza A as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: LAB_TOT_B_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of specimens testing positive for influenza B as reported by participating laboratories

columns.name: LAB_TOT_H1N1_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of positive influenza A specimens that were subtyped as H1N1pdm09 virus strain

columns.name: LAB_TOT_H3N2_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of positive influenza A specimens that were subtyped as H3N2 virus strain

columns.name: LAB_TOT_NOTSUBTYPED_POSITIVE
columns.description: Total number of positive influenza A specimens that were not subtyped

columns.name: LAB_TOT_TESTED_CUMULATIVE
columns.description: Cumulative total number of specimens tested for influenza in the flu season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 20 of the following year

columns.name: LAB_TOT_POSITIVE_CUMULATIVE
columns.description: Cumulative total number of specimens that were positive for influenza in the flu season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 20 of the following year

columns.name: LAB_PCT_POSITIVE_CUMULATIVE
columns.description: Cumulative percentage of specimens that were positive for influenza  in the flu season, which goes from week 40 of each year to week 20 of the following year

columns.name: ILI_PCT_POSITIVE_ILINET
columns.description: Percentage of outpatient visits that were due to influenza-like illness as reported by participating clinics enrolled in ILINet

columns.description: Total number of emergency department visits that were due to influenza-like illness as reported by participating hospitals enrolled in ESSENCE

columns.name: ILI_PCT_POSITIVE_ESSENCE
columns.description: Percentage of emergency department visits that were due to influenza-like illness as reported by participating hospitals enrolled in ESSENCE
